//==
// # Thermal and chemical quantities
//
// Absolute temperature and its delta type, the two heat-transport constants,
// and amount of substance (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Thermodynamics).
// `Temperature` is an absolute (kelvin) reading and `TemperatureDelta` is the
// difference between two of them - they share a unit but not a meaning, so a
// delta is never a temperature.

// Absolute temperature, stored in kelvin
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Thermodynamic_temperature).
type Temperature implements IQuantity { Kelvin: Number; }
